shared_tail.surface: يوسف بن الحكم بن أبي سفيان
حفص بن عمر بن عبد الرحمن بن عوف

notes: Two branches (مخلد to أبو عاصم, and عباس to روح) meet at ابن جريج, written once after the last ح; the main route ends at حفص and عمرو, the Companion appears only in the variants.
Low confidence: Abbas's remark gives ابن حنة for the Yusuf level and Abu Dawud's remark (فقال جعفر بن عمرو) is not stored as a link.
The two remarks and Amr b. Hayya's remark are variant groups, never routes; the Prophet's saying is the end.
